ir11_war.topic: The 2026 war: run-up (January crackdown, Jan-Feb talks), 28 February strikes and stated aims, Khamenei's killing and succession, Iran's response, tolls, international response

claims.text: Protests began in late December 2025 over the rial's collapse (about 1.4 million to the dollar) and cost of living, largest since 2022; 2 Jan 2026 Trump: if Iran 'violently kills peaceful protesters' the US 'will come to their rescue... We are locked and loaded and ready to go'; Larijani blamed Israel and US without evidence; Qalibaf said US bases would be 'legitimate targets'
11 Jan 2026 Netanyahu to cabinet: 'Israel is closely monitoring developments in Iran'; hoped 'the Persian nation will soon be freed from the yoke of tyranny'

21 Jan 2026 Martyrs Foundation (via state TV) gave first official toll of 3,117 killed; authorities called it 'terrorist' riots fuelled by the US; HRANA 4,519 killed incl. 4,251 protesters and 197 security personnel, 9,049 more under review; Amnesty documented security forces firing rifles and metal-pellet shotguns at heads and torsos
23 Jan 2026 HRANA toll topped 5,000 (at least 5,002); AP could not verify because internet cut for over two weeks; Iran's government has undercounted past unrest

6 Feb 2026 indirect US-Iran talks in Muscat: Araghchi; Witkoff with Kushner; Omani FM Busaidi mediating; Iran limited talks to nuclear, US wanted missiles and regional groups too; US added a carrier group; Iran warned it would retaliate against US bases

26 Feb 2026 Geneva round ended with 'significant progress' per Oman's FM; technical talks in Vienna next week; Trump: 'My preference is to solve this problem through diplomacy'; Iran insisted on right to enrich

27 Feb 2026 Trump 'not happy with the fact that they're not willing to give us what we have to have', did not want Iran to enrich any uranium; Busaidi said deal within reach, Iran willing to give up enriched uranium and allow comprehensive inspections; IAEA could not confirm Iran had stopped enriching (no access to bombed sites); US Embassy Jerusalem authorized departure; one carrier in place and another heading there

28 Feb: Israel called its strikes pre-emptive, 200 jets hit 500+ targets; IRGC targeted Fifth Fleet in Bahrain and US bases; one killed in Tel Aviv area; UAE: two killed, 137 missiles and 209 drones; IRGC moved to close Hormuz; 1 Mar state TV confirmed Khamenei's death; daughter, son-in-law, granddaughter, Pakpour and Shamkhani also killed; judiciary said 108 died at Minab girls' school (AFP could not verify); Guterres warned of 'chain of events that no one can control'; Russia 'dangerous adventure'; Gulf states condemned Iran's 'cowardly' attacks; Oman FM 'dismayed'
1 Mar 2026 interim council under Article 111: President Pezeshkian, chief justice Mohseni-Ejei, Ayatollah Alireza Arafi (Guardian Council); Pezeshkian: 'legitimate duty and right to avenge'

8 Mar 2026 Assembly of Experts named Mojtaba Khamenei, 'a mid-ranking cleric with close ties to the powerful Revolutionary Guards'; ruling ideology 'frowns on the principle of hereditary succession' (Reuters)
HRANA methodology: incidents inside Iran only; field reports, medical sources, open sources; uses minimum values; as of 21 Mar 1,406 civilians (213+ children), 1,167 military, 657 unclassified

Iran's Foundation of Martyrs head Ahmad Mousavi, 18 Apr: 3,468 killed; Legal Medicine 3,375 on 12 Apr; HRANA 7 Apr: at least 3,636 (1,701 civilians incl. 254 children, 1,221 military, 714 unclassified); AFP cannot verify
IDF spokesman 22 Mar: Iran fired over 400 ballistic missiles at Israel, about 92% interception

Israeli deaths from Iranian strikes: Times of Israel 10 Apr reported 24 killed (may include 4 Palestinians in West Bank) and 7,000+ injured over 40 days; later 26-28 by other counts; about 650 missiles fired at Israel to 8 April

Amnesty: 1 Mar Iranian ballistic missile hit Ramat Lehi, Beit Shemesh, killing nine civilians incl. four teenagers, ~46 injured; 'must be investigated as a war crime'; at least 23 killed in other GCC countries as of 27 March

Amnesty: 28 Feb US Tomahawk strike on Shajareh Tayyebeh school, Minab, killed 150+ incl. 120 children; US 'did not take all feasible precautions'; White House said 10 Mar investigation ongoing; Trump said not 'on purpose'; no findings published as of 25 June

Airwars: 40-day war 28 Feb-8 Apr; US and Israel declared 17,000+ targets struck; ~650 ballistic missiles and thousands of drones at Israel; ~6,400 missiles and drones at Gulf states; at least 10 seafarers killed; incident counts not aggregate tolls

UNSCR 2817, 11 Mar 2026: 13-0-2 (Russia, China abstaining), Bahrain for GCC and Jordan, endorsed by up to 135 states; demands Iran cease attacks on Gulf states; Iran's envoy Iravani: 'lasting stain'; Russian draft calling for end of hostilities without blame failed 4-2-9 (US, Latvia against)
DAWN (advocacy group) urged Iran, a non-party to the Rome Statute, to lodge an Article 12(3) declaration; no ICC action on the 2026 war reported
Commons Library: US and Israel stated aims of regime change and targeting nuclear and missile programmes; US said self-defence; UK did not join strikes
NPR 28 Feb: Trump 'imminent threats from the Iranian regime', 'take over your government'; Netanyahu 'remove the existential threat'; IAEA said no evidence enrichment resumed

ir11_now.topic: From ceasefire to blockade: 8 April ceasefire, Islamabad memorandum, its collapse, the blockade, IAEA and NPT, oil, status as of October 2026

claims.text: Ceasefire: Pakistani-mediated two-week truce 7-8 April, extended; Islamabad Memorandum 17 June; collapsed 8 July

13 Apr: after weekend talks collapsed, Trump announced Navy would block ships entering or leaving Hormuz; CENTCOM narrowed to vessels to and from Iran; Brent above $103, had topped $119 in March and passed $111 on 7 April; 17 vessels crossed vs ~130 a day pre-war
29 Apr: Grossi said Iran's near weapons-grade stockpile 'is accessible if there's a wish to go there'; inspectors had not visited the sites in 10 months

Memorandum text (released by US, dated 17 June): immediate and permanent end of operations on all fronts incl. Lebanon; US to lift blockade within 30 days; Iran to restore Hormuz transit within 30 days; Iran reaffirms it will not acquire nuclear weapons; stockpile disposal by on-site dilution under IAEA supervision; enrichment to be discussed later; Treasury oil waivers on signing; frozen funds; reconstruction plan of at least $300bn; final agreement within 60 days, to be ratified by binding UNSC resolution

24 Jun: Grossi said inspectors would visit enrichment sites under the memorandum, 'This is going to happen'; Gharibabadi: issues decided 'only within the framework of a final agreement'; IAEA had no access to bombed sites since June 2025; Iran and IAEA say Iran is not enriching

Collapse: Iran told ships to use its 'safe route'; 7 Jul three tankers hit near Oman, CENTCOM blamed Iran; Treasury reimposed oil sanctions; 8 Jul US struck 80+ targets; IRGC hit targets in Bahrain and Kuwait; Trump said MoU 'over'; Iran FM: 'flagrant violation of Paragraph 1'; Ghalibaf cited reinstated oil sanctions

Blockade reinstated mid-July after three-week reprieve; Kpler: Iran loaded ~740,000 bpd in July, ~260,000 bpd in August (vs 1.7m bpd Aug 2025); TankerTrackers 100% plunge; SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei threatened a 'maritime exclusion zone'
7 Sep 2026 Grossi: no access to affected facilities, 'lost continuity of knowledge' over declared inventories
8 Sep: Grossi 'more than a year since the Agency lost continuity of knowledge' over 60% uranium; Baghaei blamed US and Israeli attacks
IAEA Board 9 Sep 2026: 23-3-8 (Russia, China, Niger against) to report Iran to UNSC and GA, first in 20 years; Iran's Najafi: 'completely counterproductive'
As of 29 Sep 2026 no formal NPT withdrawal notice reported; Kremlin against withdrawal

Late Sep: Iran offered to reopen Hormuz within a week if US lifted blockade, freed assets and waived oil sanctions; Trump rejected ('losing so badly'); Iran received US response 1 Oct; Pezeshkian: 'We will make every effort to bring the agreement to fruition'
EIA 6 Oct 2026: Brent forecast $105 in 4Q26, $96 average 2026; Middle East flows constrained through 4Q; US gasoline $4.35 in September

8 Oct 2026 Trump: US 'will not be attacking Iran at any time prior to the Midterm Elections' on 3 November; 'productive discussions'; Araghchi to reply within days; third carrier could arrive end of October

Al Jazeera 9 Oct: Trump earlier said conflict 'is going to end immediately after the elections'; told Time more bombing after vote 'possible'; ~20,000 US forces with at least three carrier groups; reports of plans for strikes
CBS 13 Oct: blockade since 14 July; CENTCOM 4 vessels disabled, 135 turned around; Iran attacking ships in Hormuz; no direct US-Iran combat reported in period
US cost $43.6bn to 3 Sep (CENTCOM); 21 US dead, 865 wounded (Pentagon, 9 Oct)

ir11_audit.topic: Audit re-verification of high-risk Part Eleven claims (October 2026)

claims.text: 28 Feb 2026: Magen David Adom said a woman was killed and at least 21 injured in the Tel Aviv area; AFP heard blasts in Dubai, Doha, Manama and Riyadh; the EU called developments 'perilous'; Iran's UN envoy accused the US and Israel of a possible 'war crime' by attacking civilians; Iran's judiciary confirmed Pakpour and Shamkhani killed; Iranian media reported Khamenei's daughter, son-in-law and granddaughter killed

Reuters: intelligence indicated Khamenei and key lieutenants would meet at his compound in Tehran, meeting moved up to Saturday morning; reporting 'does not suggest that Netanyahu forced Trump to go to war'; WH spokeswoman Anna Kelly did not address the call
Shamkhani wrote on X before 26 Feb 2026 that Araghchi had 'sufficient support and authority' to reach a final agreement

Minab: as of 13 July 2026 the Pentagon said the investigation was ongoing, no findings released; Reuters reported 5 March that an initial internal investigation found US forces likely responsible, with targeters apparently using out-of-date intelligence; Adm. Cooper testified in May the school sat on an active Iranian cruise missile base; Trump 24 June: 'I don't think it was us'; Iranian officials say more than 175 children and teachers killed; more than two dozen Democratic senators led by Gillibrand demanded findings

7 Jul 2026 three tankers hit near Oman's coast, CENTCOM blamed Iran; Treasury reimposed oil sanctions; 8 Jul CENTCOM hit over 80 targets incl. more than 60 IRGC small boats; IRGC said it hit US targets in Bahrain and Kuwait; Trump said MoU over at NATO summit in Ankara; Ghalibaf listed 'Violating Iranian adjustments in the Strait' among US violations

Trump announced the blockade on Sunday 12 April 2026; effective 13 April 10:00 ET; CENTCOM narrowed it to vessels to and from Iran; 17 vessels crossed on Saturday 11 April (Windward) vs ~130 a day pre-war

UNSCR 2817: 13-0 with Russia and China abstaining; Bahrain for GCC with Jordan; Waltz: 'This is exactly what the United Nations should be about'; Russian draft 4 in favour (Russia, China, Pakistan, Somalia), US and Latvia against, 9 abstentions

Al Jazeera 8 Jul 2026: 'Local television reported that the ships had ignored warnings to change direction from Iranian forces'; Iran's 'safe route' map marked part of Omani territorial waters as a 'restricted zone'
